about: The rebalance rehearsal's real re-slice, as a replay: the same three-story plan signed off and re-sliced to extended, three stories becoming two. Every write step is issued once, in the recoverable order, and the rewire is verified with no orphans before anything is archived.

script.output:
SESSION MODEL: MATCH
The session runs the planning model the profile names.
```json
{"verdict": "MATCH", "profileLine": "standard: planning on the configured model"}
```

REBALANCE GATES: CLEAR
No build loop holds the plan and the auto-scheduler is off.
```json
{"root": "I100", "target": "extended", "dryRun": false}
```

PLAN STATE: PARTIAL
Read every level under I100, descriptions and comments.
```json
{"state": "PARTIAL", "doneOpenCounts": {"done": 0, "open": 3}, "orphans": [], "deferredContainer": null}
```

REBALANCE PARTITION: PARTITIONED 3-0
Three stories not started; none done, in progress or landed.
```json
{"notStarted": ["I103", "I104", "I105"], "untouchable": [], "current": "standard", "target": "extended"}
```

REBALANCE PROPOSAL: SIGNED OFF
The person answered yes, rebalance.
```json
{"proposal": [{"successor": "Stories one and two, merged", "absorbs": ["I103", "I104"]}, {"successor": "Story three, kept as it is", "absorbs": ["I105"]}], "proof": {"kind": "rebalance-sign-off"}}
```

SCHEDULER PROBE: HELD
The probe date read back unchanged and was restored.
```json
{"probe": "I104 held 2026-12-03"}
```

REBALANCE SUCCESSORS: CREATED 2
Two successors created, each carrying its absorbed specs word for word.
```json
{"map": {"I106": ["I103", "I104"], "I107": ["I105"]}}
```

REBALANCE REWIRE: DONE 1
The second successor is blocked by the first; both were read back with an edge.
```json
{"orphans": 0, "proof": {"kind": "wired-plan", "orphans": 0}}
```

REBALANCE RENUMBER: DONE 4-5
The successors carry the next free numbers; no existing item was renumbered.
```json
{"range": "4-5"}
```

REBALANCE ARCHIVE: ARCHIVED 3
The three originals are archived, never deleted.
```json
{"archived": ["I103", "I104", "I105"]}
```

REBALANCE MARKER: REWRITTEN extended
The root's profile marker now reads extended.
```json
{"profile": "extended"}
```

GANTT: DATED 2
Two open stories dated from the start the plan had before the re-slice.
```json
{"dated": 2, "start": "2026-12-01"}
```

REBALANCE REPORT: RE-SLICED 3-2
Three stories became two.
```json
{"before": 3, "after": 2, "next": "I106"}
```
